verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an AI app-building platform, but the evidence documents no first-party bulk-operation capability, such as batch edits across projects, pages, or records. The closest item is the MCP execute_sql tool for database writes. That is a general developer primitive a user could use to build mass updates, not a documented bulk-operations feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
